    • getSuperType

      @NotNull public @NotNull EntityData<?> getSuperType()
      Description copied from class: EntityData
      Returns a more general version of this EntityData with specific data removed.

      For example, calling this on "a saddled pig" should return "a pig". This is typically used to obtain the base entity type without any modifiers or traits.

      Specified by:
      getSuperType in class EntityData<org.bukkit.entity.Cushion>
